def page(items, cursor, size):
    """Return (slice, next_cursor) for items[cursor:cursor+size].

    """

        raise ValueError("size must be positive")
    n = len(items)
    if cursor < 0 or cursor > n:
        raise ValueError("cursor out of range")
    end = cursor + size
    if end >= n:
        return list(items[cursor:n]), None
    return list(items[cursor:end]), end

    result = []

    while True:
        rows, cursor = page(snapshot, cursor, size)
        result.extend(rows)
        if cursor is None:
